name: Culqi

webhook.algorithm: UNKNOWN. Culqi documents webhook configuration via CulqiPanel (Eventos > Webhooks) but publishes NO signature header, algorithm or verification example. Do not invent one. Generator should emit event-id dedup plus a mandatory re-fetch of the charge via GET /charges/{id} before trusting any state change, and a comment flagging the gap.

evidence.note: Catalog import from adversarially-checked research. The scheme above is quoted from that research and has NOT been transcribed into typed fields, so PagoKit will not generate a verifier. Promoting this provider to generic or build means reading the provider docs and typing the scheme in.

credentials.note: VERIFIED. Public: `pk_(test|live)_XXXX`. Secret: `sk_(test|live)_XXXX`. Same shape as Stripe — safe to reuse the ^(pk|sk)_(test|live)_[A-Za-z0-9]{10,}$ style pattern.

fees.notes: UNKNOWN for 2026. Third-party comparisons circulate figures but no verified Culqi rate card was confirmed. Do not populate.

notes: The only genuinely self-serve Peruvian gateway with Stripe-shaped ergonomics, and the most common route to Yape — which has 15M+ active users and no self-serve API of its own. regions.json lists Peru as Mercado Pago only and defers Culqi to 'Phase 2'.
SDKs: Official Culqi-maintained libraries on GitHub for Node, Python, PHP, Ruby, Go, Java and .NET (github.com/culqi/*). Good coverage.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps izipay and niubiz in PE. Culqi wins on developer experience and self-serve signup; Niubiz wins on bank relationships and rates at volume.
Onboarding model was inferred during the catalog import and is not verified. Confirm it before relying on the "can this user actually get keys" filter.
